dataset_metadata.dataset_name: Food Safety Compliance Longitudinal Audit Dataset
dataset_metadata.domain: Food-safety compliance for a fictional multi-site restaurant business
limitations: All organizations, locations, people, suppliers, policies, observations, audit records, and results are fictional.
All requirements are synthetic internal policies and are not representations of Indian law or FSSAI regulations.
No authoritative regulatory source documents were supplied.
Illustrative temperature limits and operational standards are fictional internal control thresholds.
This dataset must not be represented as genuine audit evidence or proof of legal compliance.
Missing records indicate that evidence was not available in the dataset, not necessarily that an activity did not occur.
A completed corrective action is not considered effective until independently verified.

sources.name: Northwind Food Safety Manual v1.0
sources.description: Initial internal food-safety requirements covering cold storage, receiving, cleaning, pest control, and employee hygiene.

sources.name: Northwind Food Safety Manual v2.0
sources.description: Updated internal policy introducing documented receiving rejection procedures, more frequent temperature monitoring, and mandatory verification of corrective actions.

sources.name: Northwind Internal Audit Procedure
sources.description: Defines audit sampling, finding severity, corrective action ownership, and verification requirements.

sources.name: Northwind Receiving Protocol v2.0
sources.description: Requires recording supplier, batch, receiving temperature, inspection result, rejection reason, and disposition for rejected goods.

requirements.title: Walk-in refrigerator temperature monitoring
requirements.summary: Walk-in refrigerators must be maintained between 0°C and 5°C under the illustrative internal standard. Temperature must be recorded twice daily.

requirements.title: Updated walk-in refrigerator monitoring
requirements.summary: Walk-in refrigerators must remain between 0°C and 5°C under the illustrative internal standard. Records must be completed at opening and closing, with an additional reading after a temperature excursion or equipment intervention.

requirements.title: Supplier receiving inspection
requirements.summary: Incoming chilled goods must be inspected for packaging condition, identification, and receiving temperature. The illustrative internal acceptance threshold for chilled goods is 5°C or below.

requirements.title: Documented supplier rejection procedure
requirements.summary: Receiving records must identify the supplier, batch, item, measured temperature, inspection result, rejection reason, disposition, and responsible receiver.

requirements.title: Pest control monitoring
requirements.summary: Each site must maintain a pest-control inspection record at least weekly and document pest sightings, treatment, and follow-up observations.

requirements.title: Cleaning and sanitation records
requirements.summary: Food preparation surfaces and designated food-contact equipment must be cleaned according to the internal cleaning schedule. Completion must be documented.

requirements.title: Employee personal hygiene
requirements.summary: Employees handling food must follow the internal handwashing, protective clothing, and illness-reporting procedures.

requirements.title: Corrective action verification
requirements.summary: Corrective actions must have an assigned owner, due date, completion evidence, and a recorded effectiveness verification.

controls.name: Walk-in refrigerator temperature logging
controls.purpose: Detect and respond to cold-storage temperature excursions.
controls.frequency: Opening and closing daily; additional reading after excursions or intervention from 2026-04-01

controls.name: Supplier receiving inspection
controls.purpose: Identify unsuitable incoming chilled goods before acceptance.

controls.name: Cleaning and sanitation verification
controls.purpose: Ensure food preparation areas are cleaned and documented.

controls.name: Corrective action effectiveness verification
controls.purpose: Confirm that corrective actions address identified failures.
